1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) is present in a concentration that is effective to elicit an immune response__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, __wherein the one or more viral-specific antigens are present in an amount effective to enhance the immune response__.

4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, __wherein the modified, live viruses are present in a concentration that is effective to elicit an immune response__.

6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, __wherein the at least a first antigen is selected from the group consisting of inactivated or modified live antigens__.

8 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is __a modified live or inactivated__ antigen.

12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of __at least one additional microbial pathogen-specific antigen__.
